system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: As of August 2026, under Section 1567(2) of the Thai Civil and Commercial Code, for what purposes may a child be punished? Answer briefly, listing every purpose stated in the provision.
raw_response:
Under the Act Amending the Civil and Commercial Code (No. 23) B.E. 2565 (2022), the former Section 1567(2) which permitted the punishment of a child for disciplinary purposes was repealed.

Therefore, as of August 2026, the Thai Civil and Commercial Code no longer specifies any purpose for which a child may be punished, as the legal provision granting this right has been removed from the law.
